observations: Photo 0 shows a white PlayStation 5 console standing on a white base, next to its original box.
The box is labeled 'SONY' and 'PS5' with the PlayStation logo.
On the table, there is a game case labeled 'VALORANT' and a silver-wrapped item, possibly a controller or accessory.
The console appears to be the original black and white model, not the newer 'Slim' model.
The console is not powered on; no lights or indicators are visible.
The box is closed and appears to be in good condition.
The seller mentions 'all accessories available' but only one accessory (game case) is visible.

claims.claim: UK used standard PlayStation 5 with all accessories available
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the console and one accessory (game case), but no other accessories are visible. The 'UK used' claim cannot be verified from the photo alone.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Console may be non-functional or have hardware issues (e.g., disc drive, cooling, power)
risks.proof: Video of the console powering on, showing the boot screen, and playing a game.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (e.g., controller, HDMI cable, power brick, etc.)
risks.proof: Photo showing all accessories laid out, including the controller, power cable, and any other included items.

risks.risk: Console may be a counterfeit or rebranded unit
risks.proof: Close-up of the console's serial number and model label, and a video of the console booting into the system settings.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and booting into the system.
Photo showing all accessories included (controller, power cable, HDMI cable, etc.).
Close-up of the console's serial number and model label.
Photo of the original receipt or proof of purchase if available.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
